lessonTitle: 59. Multiplying a vector by a number
lessonTitleEnglish: Multiplying a vector by a number
unit: Geometry · Chapter VIII. Coordinates and vectors
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 9 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: The vector k · a has length |k| · |a|; it points like a if k > 0 and opposite to a if k < 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: The vector k · a has length |k| · |a|; it points like a if k > 0 and opposite to a if k < 0.

stages.headline: If b = k · a then a and b are collinear; conversely, for a ≠ 0 every vector collinear to a equals k · a.
stages.headlineEnglish: If b = k · a then a and b are collinear; conversely, for a ≠ 0 every vector collinear to a equals k · a.

stages.headline: Laws: (kl)a = k(la), (k + l)a = ka + la, k(a + b) = ka + kb.
stages.headlineEnglish: Laws: (kl)a = k(la), (k + l)a = ka + la, k(a + b) = ka + kb.
